rendered: The premise is not quite right: the authors did not strain the NiTi wires beyond the stated limit. The coated wires were subjected to axial tensile deformation up to[1] 10% strains[2] at a fixed rate. Tensile deformations beyond that limit were not performed, because doing so would cause delamination of the coating from the wire surface.[3][4] The upper level was also chosen for the film physics: the substrate strains were picked to sufficiently exceed the saturation crack density reported for similar ALD films.[5][6]
